newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Kia Heavy sales up for first-half of 97.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Kia Heavy sales up for first-half of 97.

text.p: South Korea's Kia Heavy Industries' sales in the first half of this year was 256.3 billion won, up 21.6 percent from last year, Kia Group said on Saturday.
In a statement Kia said its construction machinery division's sales increased 69.6 percent to 41.6 billion won, helping to boost the overall sales figure.
The smaller robotics division posted the highest sales increase of 129 percent at 13.4 billion won, it said.
Kia Heavy forecast its sales to reach two trillion won in 2000, and said it would help the group's troubled finances.
